skill.summary: Cloud-based ai-music-video-creator tool that handles generating music videos from a song and photos. Upload MP3, WAV, JPG, PNG files (up to 500MB), describe...

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of AI Music Video Creator

- Generate 1080p MP4 music videos from your audio (MP3, WAV) and photos (JPG, PNG) using a cloud AI pipeline.
- Supports uploads up to 500MB; process completes in 1–2 minutes per video.
- Handles syncing photos to music, beat-matched transitions, lyric overlays, and more, with simple natural language prompts.
- Built-in credit system with free credits for anonymous users; automatic session and token management on first use.
- Exports high-quality videos compatible with YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, and more.
- Error handling for token expiry, file size, format, rate limits, and subscription/credit issues.
